nina (acct exec): Heads-up: CedarBridge is evaluating a switch from CompetitorZ. They want a 10-day POC focused on webhook compatibility, prompt/response parity for structured JSON outputs, and an apples-to-apples billing estimate.
sam (solutions): Good. Do they rely on function-calling or custom JSON embeddings? Need to know exact API surface to emulate.
nina (acct exec): They use function-style structured outputs heavily (choices -> content as JSON) and validate via a strict schema downstream.
devin (engineer): Important parity note: CompetitorZ returns a choices[] array with a top-level 'content' string; our streaming delta emits token diffs and patches. For schema-heavy workflows we should run a non-streaming mode and a small rewrapping shim that converts our events to choices[].
marcus (security): CedarBridge also asked for SCIM SSO + SCIM provisioning samples and a copy of our SOC2. They require audit log forwarding to their SIEM and a list of data-at-rest encryption details.
sam (solutions): Ask them for 20 representative prompts plus the validation schema they use. We'll run both systems and produce a parity report: schema pass rate, token delta, average latency, and example diffs for failing cases.
devin (engineer): For token differences, note tokenizers differ on complex punctuation and emojis. We'll include a mini token-estimator script they can run locally: 
```
# quick token estimate
python3 -c "from rwd_tokenizer import estimate; print(estimate('<<their prompt>>'))"
```
sam (solutions): Pricing: prepare two scenarios — hosted per-token pricing and Dedicated reserved capacity with throughput-based billing. Show a 3-month projection and a recommended POC credit (25%) to cover integration runover.
contract-bot: NDA template and SOC2 link posted: https://contracts.redwood.ai/nda and https://security.redwood.ai/soc2.pdf
marcus (security): CedarBridge insists on EU-only processing and wants KMS key wrapping with customer-managed keys. Also ask if they require egress filtering to block certain ASN ranges.
nina (acct exec): I'll ask for the schema and 20 prompts today. Can we assemble the POC bundle if they send artifacts by tomorrow?
devin (engineer): Yes — pack will include: a small rewrap shim (node/python), token-delta table, sample configs for non-streaming and sampling params (temp/top_p/logit_bias), and a short integration checklist.
sam (solutions): Also flag potential blocker: CompetitorZ auto-trims system messages in some SDKs; if their validation relies on exact system prefixes we may need to normalize prompts during POC.
marcus (security): I'll prepare the security questionnaire and confirm EU Dedicated lead time (likely 4 business days). Add me once NDA signed.
nina (acct exec): Excellent. I'll update CedarBridge: we can do the 10-day POC, need schema + prompts + security contact, expect POC pack in 3 business days after artifacts, Dedicated EU lead time ~4 days, recommend 25% POC credit.
sam (solutions): 44c will run the parallel tests when prompts arrive and post a short summary.
contract-bot: One-way NDA can be issued once legal contact supplied.
